name: pitv
description: Native PiTV appliance, media service and phone companion

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace app run typecheck && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.vm:tv:rebuild: vagrant ssh -c "sudo cp -r /vagrant/native/CMakeLists.txt /vagrant/native/qml.qrc /vagrant/native/src /vagrant/native/qml /vagrant/native/fonts /vagrant/native/tests /opt/pitv-native/src/ && sudo cmake --build /opt/pitv-native/build --parallel 4 && sudo cmake --install /opt/pitv-native/build && (sudo pkill -x pitv-native || true)"
